title: 2025 Heart 'O Texas Fair & Rodeo: What's New, Including The Leadership - NewsBreak
text:
By Vince Erickson No media credit provided. ,
7 hours ago
WACO ( FOX 44 ) — Believe it or not, the 2025 Heart ‘O Texas Fair & Rodeo is only a couple of weeks away. While some things will remain the same as in past years, there are some things new – including the leadership.
Dustin Coufal is the new President & CEO of the Heart ‘O Texas Fair & Rodeo. He told FOX 44 News at Wednesday’s Media Kickoff Luncheon about what will remain the same.
“There haven’t been any wrinkles. Everything has been a really smooth transition,” Coufal said. “And, you know, we have a great staff and a great team here, along with a great set of volunteers. And so, that makes it really easy when you have great people behind you to keep on moving forward.”
There was plenty of applause for some of what will be new in 2025.
“We have a new lineup in terms of the ZiegenBock Music stage, a great set of Texas artists and even some local artists that are getting on the big stage,” Coufal said. “The rodeo is going to be exciting this year. We talked about it is the Texas Circuit final Permit finals Rodeo.”
Coufal stressed he’s most excited about the Heart ‘O Texas Fair and Rodeo’s scholarship program, which gave out $313,000 in 2024.
“I don’t want to always put a dollar amount on it, but our ultimate goal, whether it’s this year in the future, is to write and to give over a half a million dollars in scholarships,” Coufal said. “And we’re going to continue moving that needle each and every year. And and like I said, the simple goal is we want to beat last year of what we give out to kiddos.”
Even though the fair does run from October 2nd through the 12th, There are some events that start a little bit earlier, including this coming Saturday where they will have the one hot barbecue cookoff. It starts at 8 a.m. and it is at the BASE at Extraco Events Center, and it will be an all day affair.
